scope: Actual source cache/model resolution, native asset-reader test, and additive visual/PF provider. No cache asset was copied or staged.

wiring: The context strongly pins navigation, roots, and candidate cache. The Application-owned CanonicalObjectManager is observed weakly to avoid a context/record/manager retain cycle.
provider_api.bind_boundary: The visual provider runs at V60 C1 construction before InitPost writes model290; bind does not inspect or initialize model/xref strings. It preserves root-supplied animation manager/dictionary/registration/selection/events/FX services.

source_actor_fields.model_290: data/3D/characters/npcs/Priest_good.bdae, produced by CharacterGenericInitPostOwnerV61 after GetCharModelName (0x3a54d4)
source_actor_fields.xref_2a8: empty source C1 string; no fixture or CharacterProperties field supplies an alternate subscene

resolution_path: CanonicalCharacterCandidateRecordV60 dispatches 0x3a54d4 using properties.resolved[3] and the actual Character model dictionary.
CharacterGenericInitPostOwnerV61 stores the returned URI in the same actor's model290 string.
RetainedCharacterActorV1::visual_strings_v6 borrows the same actor model290/xref2a8 strings.
CharacterVisualAssetOwnerV6::load_visual requests that exact model URI and xref from its retained asset reader.

native_cache_test.result: PASS: CharacterCandidateCacheV62 loaded and its files().read returned the 42,136-byte valid Priest_good BRES
native_cache_test.qualification: The reader is an explicit layered source reader used by this test, not evidence that the fixture PyData directory alone is a complete source cache.

visual_pf_composition.candidate_world_identity: CharacterFamilyVisualServicesV6.world must equal record.services.world exactly. A typed in-house Windows backend lifetime context can own the same navigation capsule, roots, candidate cache, and canonical manager; this visual leaf only checks the non-null/equal lifetime token and does not downcast it. Later actual Level/script providers remain separate.
visual_pf_composition.scene_manager: Capture the same shared GameObjectSceneRootRegistryV1 used by the retained source visual connection.
visual_pf_composition.navigation: Capture the one shared SourceNavigationWorldStorage. It must already retain the actual sewn floors::World and its sole obstacle registry/storage; do not create another registry for the visual actor.
visual_pf_composition.update_pf: Weak-lock the same CanonicalCharacterCandidateRecordV60, then call canonical_character_update_pf_v62(*record, nav->floors->collision_world, nav->registry, error). The capsule and registry stay strongly pinned by the callback. This is the source Character PF producer, not a no-op callback.
visual_pf_composition.visual_asset_owner: Set RetainedGameObjectVisualServicesV1.owner to record.services.world and read_asset to the SAME candidate cache's ScriptAssetServicesV1 reader, rooted at the actual original-cache root. Let RetainedCharacterVisualConnectionV5 supply same-registry root registration, force-register, destruction, and root GameObject identity services.
callback_order: RetainedCharacterFamilyVisualV6::bind borrows visual fields and model/xref strings from the same actor and invokes the actual UpdatePFObject callback when the source mesh bounds are applied.
RetainedCharacterVisualConnectionV5 constructs the retained visual from the actual BRES bytes and registers its root in the captured same SceneManager.
The visual applies its mesh bounds to the same Character and invokes canonical_character_update_pf_v62 through the shared navigation capsule.

not_proven: The current native fixture still uses std::make_shared<int>(1) for services.world; it is not a typed in-house backend lifetime context and retains none of navigation, roots, candidate cache, or canonical manager.

The native fixture's provided PyData root has no model BRES at the resolved URI. The separately located original-cache BRES was read and opened through CharacterCandidateCacheV62 in the owned asset test, but not yet loaded by the native factory fixture.
No native visual LoadVisual, root registration, mesh-bounds UpdatePF, PF obstacle insertion, full SceneManager rendering registration, or completed InitPost is claimed.
SourceNavigationWorldStorage must be given the same actual sewn floor authority and used without duplicate floor/obstacle storage; this report does not fabricate or publish that Level context.
